description: This file defines the ItemsEncryptionService class, which manages encryption and decryption of items, handles encryption keys, observes item changes, and provides diagnostics within a larger application.

classes.name: ItemsEncryptionService
classes.description: A service class responsible for encrypting and decrypting item payloads, managing encryption keys, observing item changes, and providing diagnostic information.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up resources and observers when the service is deinitialized.

methods.name: repersistAllItems
methods.description: Re-saves all items to storage, typically after encryption status changes.

methods.name: itemsKeyForPayload
methods.description: Finds the encryption key associated with a given payload.

methods.name: keyToUseForItemEncryption
methods.description: Determines the appropriate key for encrypting items based on user version and default key.

methods.name: keyToUseForDecryptionOfPayload
methods.description: Selects the key for decrypting a specific payload.

methods.name: encryptPayloadWithKeyLookup
methods.description: Encrypts a payload using key lookup.

methods.name: encryptPayload
methods.description: Encrypts a payload with a specified key.

methods.name: encryptPayloads
methods.description: Encrypts multiple payloads with a specified key.

methods.name: encryptPayloadsWithKeyLookup
methods.description: Encrypts multiple payloads using key lookup.

methods.name: decryptPayloadWithKeyLookup
methods.description: Decrypts a payload using key lookup.

methods.name: decryptPayload
methods.description: Decrypts a payload with a specified key.

methods.name: decryptPayloadsWithKeyLookup
methods.description: Decrypts multiple payloads using key lookup.

methods.name: decryptPayloads
methods.description: Decrypts multiple payloads with a specified key.

methods.name: decryptErroredPayloads
methods.description: Attempts to decrypt payloads that previously failed decryption.

methods.name: defaultItemsKeyForItemVersion
methods.description: Finds the default items key for a specific protocol version, used during migration.

methods.name: getDiagnostics
methods.description: Provides diagnostic information about the encryption state and keys.
